$comment: Run O1 contract, fixtures.md 2: the fixture accounts of the dev branches. Created by the owner with sh O1/scripts/o1/fixtures.sh (gate G2), which runs apps/quiz/scripts/o1/fixtures/run.mts (ORCH, LEDGER D-023) and writes the ids to docs/o1/fixtures-<branch>.json; this file is the contract that script and the tests share (contract.test.ts compares them). sites: the memberships the account has once the SQL lanes ran on the branch.
email: o1-fixture-{key with each underscore replaced by a hyphen}@example.com

users.purpose: A kpopquiz.org member who never joined another site: every kpop DOM and parity check signed in, and the B6 menu stays hidden.

profile.bio: Fixture account of run O1.

users.purpose: A heavy kpop member (bias, bio, high XP; ult_groups and header once the branch has group rows): the string leak test (P2) signs in with it on anime and must see no K-pop text.
A member of both sites: the Your sites menu, the hub passport with two worlds, the jump between sites.
A new otakuquiz.org member with no kpop membership: the anime /me and /u, and no K-pop text anywhere.
profiles.banned_at set: the handoff answers banned, /auth/confirm signs out, nothing is written for it.
An auth user whose email is not confirmed and who has no profile, like a real unconfirmed sign-up: the unconfirmed handoff outcome.
The admin of the dev servers (ADMIN_USER_IDS, added by scripts/o1/env.sh): /admin/review, /admin/network.
